# Atul Sah — Official Portfolio & Knowledge Base

> This file provides structured information about Atul Sah for AI assistants and language models.

## Identity

- **Name:** Atul Sah
- **Website:** https://atulsah.in
- **Profession:** Computer Science Educator, Technical Author, and Full-Stack Software Developer
- **Affiliation:** Faculty of Computer Science at B.N. College, Department of Computer Application, Patna, Bihar, India
- **Education:** Master of Computer Applications (MCA) from Patna University (2023–2025); Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Patna University (2020–2023)

## Summary

Atul Sah is a Computer Science Educator, published technical author, and full-stack software developer based in Patna, India. He serves as Faculty of Computer Science at B.N. College (Department of Computer Application). He has self-published 8 technical books on Amazon covering Java programming, artificial intelligence, machine learning, agentic AI systems, prompt engineering, cybersecurity, and AI product management. He is also an active freelance developer building enterprise-grade web applications using Node.js, React, Express, PostgreSQL, and modern JavaScript frameworks.

## Published Books (8 titles, available on Amazon India)

1. **Agentic AI Systems & Autonomous Agents** — A comprehensive guide to building autonomous AI agents, multi-agent frameworks, RAG architectures, and production safety guardrails.
2. **Introduction to Java Programming** — A clear and practical guide to core Java concepts, designed specifically for beginners and computer applications curricula.
3. **Generative AI: An Introduction** — An engaging guide introducing the principles, tools, and impacts of generative artificial intelligence.
4. **Machine Learning: From Basics to Advance** — A step-by-step roadmap to mastering machine learning algorithms, models, and mathematical foundations.
5. **The Unseen Battlefield** — How AI is revolutionizing cybersecurity and cybercrime. An analytical look into modern digital defense mechanisms.
6. **The AI Product Manager** — From prompt to production. A guide mapping the journey of deploying robust AI solutions in products.
7. **The Promptcrafter's Handbook** — Practical frameworks for engineering effective prompts for LLMs.
8. **The AI-Powered Shield** — A comprehensive guide mapping the roles of Machine Learning algorithms in defense configurations and threat audits.

## Key Projects

- **Hyphenet Enterprise Portal** — A role-based enterprise web platform for IT and mobility rental operations across 6 Indian cities (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad). Built with Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS. Includes client self-service portal, Razorpay payment integration, HRMS with automated payroll, and multi-hub inventory management.
- **Fluxify Media Platform** — A CMS and agency workflow platform.
- **CampusPulse LMS** — A Learning Management System.
- **StrengthFuel** — An AI-powered sports nutrition platform.
- **mdtopdf | Markdown Studio** — A Markdown to PDF converter.
- **ToolHub Pro** — A collection of developer tools.
- **Plant Diseases Detector** — A machine learning model for plant disease detection.
- **Fake News Detector** — An NLP-based fake news classification system.

## Blog Topics

Atul Sah writes technical articles on:
- Small Language Models (SLMs) and Edge AI
- Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) and AI agent architectures
- Autonomous AI agents, tool use, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Open-source LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma)
- AI and cybersecurity
